message: The other day, I found myself patting myself on the back for finally being the prepared one in the family. After years of hearing my kids talk about ‘what if’ scenarios, I spent an afternoon putting together a little go-bag for emergencies. As I tucked in some snacks and water, I couldn’t help but smile at the thought that maybe, just maybe, I’d be the calm in the storm for once. It’s a small step, but it feels good to be ready! Have you ever felt that little rush of being the one with a plan?
